editor_note: The translation is faithful and reads naturally, and it keeps the source's claims intact. The shots/precision sentence in [4] ("uma precisão menor normalmente requer mais shots") matches the English as written, and the caveat that a noise model goes stale is preserved as "fica desatualizado após certo tempo ... dentro de uma sessão".

All five rewritten entries (8, 17, 35, 36, 38) keep the English meaning, including both "apenas" restrictions in entry 8 ("EstimatorV2 do lado do servidor" / "Executor e o novo Estimator do lado do cliente") and "número máximo de camadas a aprender" in entry 17, and they render "client-side" consistently as "do lado do cliente".

One sentence makes a stronger claim than the source. In entry [4], "thanks in part to its vibrant community" became "graças em grande parte à sua vibrante comunidade", which turns "partly" into "largely". The rubric counts a strengthened claim as a FAIL. The fix is one phrase: "graças em parte". The rest of the page is faithful and reads naturally, uses "você" throughout, and keeps "framework", "pull requests" and "código aberto" consistent.

examples.suggested: Hoje, o Qiskit é o framework quântico mais popular, graças em parte à sua vibrante comunidade.

editor_note: Both rewritten entries are accurate and would not mislead a learner. Faithful and natural, using standard terms throughout: "produtos internos", "medições projetivas, que generalizam as medições na base padrão", "teorema da não-clonagem" and "estados quânticos não-ortogonais", with casual "você" ("guia você").

The meaning is accurate throughout. The asymptotic-optimality claim, the lower bound that was already known, and the quadratic boost from amplitude amplification ("amplificação de amplitude") all match the English, and the terms "modelo de consulta" and "aceleração de raiz quadrada" are correct. editor_note: Both rewritten entries are faithful: [25] keeps "phase kickback" as the page does elsewhere and renders "query gate" as "porta de consulta", and [226] keeps the "at most $2$" bound as "em no máximo $2$" with no drift.

Nothing on the page would mislead a learner. The core terms are right: matrizes de densidade, canais, medições gerais. examples.why: The parenthetical synonym is not in the source. It reads as a translator's hedge that a native technical writer would not leave in; one word is enough.

editor_note: All three short entries read faithful and natural, e.g. "Continue sua jornada de aprendizado", "trilhas de aprendizado" for "learning pathways" and "Lição em breve!", and they keep the informal register.

Entry 12 is faithful with no drift: every clause of the Credly notice is kept, including the list of shared data "(nome, endereço de e-mail e badge conquistado)", "pode compartilhar" preserving the "may", and "processador de dados terceirizado", and it uses "badge" the same way as entries 7 and 9.
